controlled_comparison_contract.baseline_adapter: test wrapper around the tracked updateItineraryBasicInfo ordering and failure semantics; it must not be an intentionally degraded surrogate
controlled_comparison_contract.candidate_adapter: typed Domain Command handler using the same logical Basic Info intent
controlled_comparison_contract.database_isolation: separate reset of the same isolated PostgreSQL fixture before each baseline and candidate run

primary_result.formula: 10000 * stale expected-version intents leaving any local or formal partial effect / all eligible paired intents for the selected write entry
primary_result.numerator: paired intents in which the expected version is stale and any provider memory, local cache, business row, receipt or logical outbox state is left partially applied
primary_result.denominator: all eligible paired selected-entry intents, including failed, retried, denied, conflicted and ambiguous attempts
primary_result.estimator: exact paired event-rate difference with one-sided 95 percent bounds; target-resource and concurrency-episode clustering retained
primary_result.measurement_environment: local isolated RealPG and deterministic Flutter fixtures; synthetic failures prove mechanics only
primary_result.success_threshold: for the local controlled profile: candidate partial-effect rate equals 0 per 10k, candidate is strictly lower than the measured legacy rate, and every hard redline equals zero; production threshold remains measurement_pending

diagnostic.claim_boundary: receipt coverage proves deterministic outcome classification, not production improvement

guardrail.margin: 0 percentage points in identical non-fault fixtures
guardrail.failure_handling: underpowered or missing comparison fails closed

no_claim_boundary: The positive TASK-P12D-010 trigger is a tracked-code mechanism decision, not a measured production improvement.
Production traffic, conflict rate, partial-write incidence, database policies and downstream side effects remain unknown.
Synthetic concurrency and crash injection in later tasks can prove mechanism safety only.
No primary result may be reported until a comparable powered baseline/candidate run and frozen owner threshold exist.
A hard redline cannot be averaged into the primary or offset by another metric.
